summary: Round 1, champion-free. The start is a platform over two kill volumes (teleport sheet *18 at z 160, the pit's catch *7); every generic arm from scratch ends on them (control / speed-equiv slide into *18 at 5.7-5.9; per-call energy and the death charge camp). Go-Explore never leaves the pit, but its archive holds the record's post-pit corridor (a trough under the platform) via the platform's SW corner. Princessburglar's search->curriculum loop on that hidden route: GE trough line 7.43 -> per-call energy K8 7.85 -> GE pump of the trough 7.95/8.20 -> GE north-east exit 9.65 -> longer pump 10.26 -> GE extension 10.71 -> consolidation 10.747 (9/9 at 10.4-10.8%). Open gate: GE12's way past *18's NE edge to 22.3% crosses ~2 u above the sheet (razor bands the curriculum could not pass). The pit itself is still unflown.
